goal: When the first cold mornings hit Joburg, my old pair always gives up the ghost, and this year they've split right across the sole. Fall/winter footwear is the category, and I'll take slip-on only, no laces, no buckles, no straps. Think of it as a quick exit stage left. Only what's on the shelf, please, nothing on back order. I'm at a desk most days, but my calendar holds a few other acts besides the ledgers, and these will be for one of them. I can spend 550 US cents, not a cent over, so that's the ceiling and the curtain comes down there. Total of 3 messages from your side, no more. The cupboard has room for whatever shape you can show me, so nothing's ruled out on that front. Wrap up inside 38 steps, otherwise it doesn't count. Nothing found? Just say so, and don't offer a substitute. Ask me what you need and I'll answer plainly, because I'd rather do the sums than guess.
